scope: Bounded frozen mature-checkpoint response diagnosis, no training or production state changes
prior_access: Existing 33tick driven-token response report and historical delay/Gamma audits were visible; new explicit quiet, real-token, replay-floor design registered before its execution
token_selection: First three distinct token ids among train[cursor:cursor+128]; phrase=train[cursor:cursor+8]. No target-driven selection
initial_state: All fields of saved learner physical state, independently cloned for diagnostic counterfactuals; production individual never reset

hypotheses.prediction: Motor token contrast absent at tick0 within identical-replay floor, resolves later. A later norm peak alone does not select optimal predictive deadline
Raw/centered motor differences resolve before Gamma/logit differences and have different centroids. Mixed filter responses may prevent a single global lag
Same-phase trajectories become more similar across repeated cycles, above same-input replay floor. Persistent drift means six cycles did not establish locking
Different real token perturbations produce motor/normalized/logit contrasts above numerical floor. This proves sensitivity, not semantic sufficiency

controls: Explicit zero sensory drive on quiet tick, input-clock baseline held
All-field quiet substep equivalence versus native settle1; same-input numerical replay
Actual drive squared norm per event and per tick recorded; not thermodynamic power
Same-input replays on each stimulus condition
Raw, centered, Gamma, projection, normalization and logit contrasts; no labels used to select peak
Hash source before/after; no optimizer/checkpoint writes
Full-length quiet control also replayed for each periodic condition; combined stimulus/control numerical bound recorded
stopping: No extra intervals or cycles after outcomes. Stop on nonfinite, source hash change, missing state, interface mismatch above max(1e-5,8*identical-replay-floor), reserved VRAM>3900MiB or total device usage>4GiB

approval.conditions: Independent design and implementation passed. Runtime all-field/native quiet equivalence, source hash and VRAM gates must pass. Corrected tick count and added full quiet replay control.

claim_limits: No active-learning capability, semantic decoding, intrinsic Hz, asymptotic stability, endogenous resonance, learned clock or PC implementation claim
checkpoint_scope: Current 1.5M learned individual has known predictive deficits. Its response cannot establish universal biological delay or topology-level causation. Older retained best weight files lack full mature state; no invented healthy baseline.
